no_adcom_quote.quote: There were no safety, efficacy, or other issues identified requiring advisory committee input, so no advisory committee meeting was convened.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the current ORBACTIV (oritavancin) NDA206334. The Division Director's ODMemo (L72), the Cross-Discipline Team Leader review (L100: 'Advisory Committee was not held for the current oritavancin NDA.'), and the Medical Review (L1055: 'An Advisory Committee Meeting was not held to discuss this application.') all independently confirm this. A prior, separate oritavancin application (NDA 22153 by Targanta) was presented to the Anti-Infective Drugs Advisory Committee on November 19, 2008 and received a Complete Response, but that meeting pertained to the earlier NDA, not this approval.
